title: 1957 Family Group Portrait, Covina CA B&W Snapshot Photo
description: A black and white snapshot from 1957 depicting four family members—Fern, Dusty, Frank, and Alta—sitting and standing together indoors. Handwritten inscriptions on the front border identify the individuals, date, and address at 570 S. Palmeda in Covina, California. The photo offers a classic glimpse into mid-20th-century American domestic life and fashion.
